I've sent Dana the answer in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 put Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats**.

- **Where it came from:** Dana's own posts in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, a channel Dana is in. Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. That's why I didn't go with the 180 from the first post.
- **Not checked against the contract:** the amendment itself isn't in any shared file I can see, so I suggested asking June Osei-Lark for the signed copy if the deck needs it.
- **May be out of date:** I also pointed out that the renewal signed 20 Mar 2026 may have changed the seat count. That matters if the deck shows current seats rather than the amendment's number.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
